claims.text: Ask: how the parent and the family are doing; the baby's day and the best and hardest times; what keeps the baby healthy and safe; anyone who smokes or uses e-cigarettes; major family changes.
claims.quote: How are you feeling? • How are things going for your family? • How are things going for your baby? Tell me about your baby’s day. What are some of the best times of day with your baby? Some of the most difficult? • What are some of the things you are doing to keep your baby healthy and safe? Does your child live with or spend time with anyone who smokes or uses e-cigarettes? Other than your baby’s birth, have there been any major changes in your family?
